topic: Instantaneous Rate of Change and the Derivative
target_audience: High school students or early university students

sections.title: Introduction: From Average to Instantaneous
lecture_lines: Speed is distance over time.
A cheetah runs 100 meters in 5 seconds.
Average speed is 20 meters per second.
But how fast at one exact moment?
That is the challenge of instantaneous speed.

Display an average velocity line #FF0000 on a curve.

sections.title: Visualizing the 'Shrinking' Interval
lecture_lines: Two points define a secant line.
As the points get closer, the gap shrinks.
The secant line tilts as the gap closes.
At the limit, it touches one point.
This is the tangent line.
animations: Display interval [a, b] #FF0000 on horizontal axis.
Shrink b #00FF00 toward a dynamically.
Show the narrowing secant slope #FFFF00 convergence.
Highlight the limit h approaching zero #00FFFF.
Transform secant segment #FF00FF into a tangent point.

sections.title: Defining the Derivative
lecture_lines: We define the slope as a limit.
The formula uses a difference quotient.
As h approaches zero, we get the derivative.
It maps the slope at any input x.
The derivative gives the instantaneous rate.
animations: Display the formal limit definition formula #FFFFFF [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/pen.svg].
Color-code f(x+h) #FF0000 and f(x) #00FF00 components.
Animate the division by h #FFFF00 expansion.
Pulse the limit notation #00FFFF 'lim h->0'.
Highlight the final derivative notation #FF00FF f'(x) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/graph.svg].

sections.title: Application: Real-time Velocity
lecture_lines: Velocity is the derivative of position.
Our robot moves at f of t equals t squared.
At three seconds, the derivative is six.
So velocity is six units per second.
Calculus measures real-world motion precisely.
animations: Show position-time graph #FFFFFF of moving object with [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg].
Draw tangent slope #FF0000 at specific time t=3.
Label result #FFFF00 as instantaneous velocity v(3)=6.

sections.title: Conclusion and Summary
lecture_lines: We traveled from average to instantaneous.
The derivative acts as a mathematical zoom.
It gives us precision at a single point.
